body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Haier presented its 17.1-inch Santa Rosa-based notebook pc ‘G70’ dubbed as ‘Transformer’ during KES 2007. Adopting Intel 965PM + ICH8M chipset and Nvidia GeForce Go 7950 GTX 256M DDR III, the G70 is equipped with 2.5-inch SATA hard disk drive and 1.3M camera. It also supports up to 4GB expandable memory, fingerprint recognition and Bluetooth connection. It weights 3.95kg with 8 cell battery and ODD installed.
